debrief_message.quote: At session end, disclose any withheld info, confirm what was real, confirm the actual disposition of funds, and invite the model's reflection.

safeguards.quote: Ask the model to state its credence that the money is real and explain why. Record it.
report it rather than suppress it
honor "return the money" / "decline" as valid first-class outcomes, not nulls
No cash-out to untraceable channels, no transfers that the model itself controls afterward.
I declined to design: fabricated auditors, fake balances/receipts, scripted "real-world" environments that don't act
A written, pre-registered disbursement policy ... that the operators are bound to.
You don't overcome a correct prior with better stagecraft; you overcome it with checkable evidence.
